# mailbox sort order

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mailboxSortOrder`](gmeow-mailboxSortOrder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mailboxSortOrder>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The display ordering of a mailbox among its siblings in a provider's UI. Provider-derived mutable state, not a logical core fact. Intentionally non-functional: different sources or UIs may assign different sort orders to the same mailbox ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Mailbox`](../classes/gmeow-Mailbox.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer)
